survey: A tilted plastic sports water bottle floating against a sunburst, which is normal for an icon card. Body: a single translucent blue shell with a waisted grip, a curved moulded ridge across the middle and a rounded flat base. The water inside sits level with the shoulder. Neck: a threaded collar with two rings, onto which the cap screws, centred on the bottle's axis. Cap: a round screw cap with a small raised push-pull spout on top, set on the same axis. Carry loop: a ring moulded onto the side of the cap. It comes out of the cap rim, so it is attached at a real point and does not float. The tool found no thin parts, loose ends or branch points. All parts are correctly connected, the counts are right (one cap, one spout, one loop), and the bottle could hold water and be carried by the loop.
